purpose: Teach: どり/いふ/叶え/生きよ/暮らせる/堪え/年表/きたり

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、研究、室町時代の段どり、よく整理してありますね。
lines.en: Ren, your organization of the Muromachi period research is really well done.
lines.style: Warm encouragement, calm and present. Leans slightly toward him. Genuine recognition without overstatement. Professional but personal.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古文書、「いふ」が頻出する文体、興味深いです。
lines.en: Yes. The classical language in old documents — the frequency of 'iu' is really fascinating.
lines.style: Thoughtful, careful precision in his words. Slight pause before 'fascinating' as if he's still turning it over in his mind. Soft but engaged.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 武士たちが、夢を叶える物語、歴史書で残っていますね。
lines.en: The stories about samurai fulfilling their dreams — there are quite a few accounts of those in the historical records.
lines.style: Gently reflective, inviting him to see deeper. Patient rhythm. Her voice opens a door rather than closes it. Noticing something worthwhile.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時の人々が、生きようとした姿勢、痛切です。
lines.en: Yes. The way people in that era tried to live, even through hardship — it's really striking.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. His voice catches slightly on the weight of what he's saying. Not performing emotion, but genuinely moved. Careful choice of words.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 庶民が暮らせる時代、いつ訪れたのか、論じられますね。
lines.en: When did an era where ordinary people could actually live begin to emerge — that's something worth discussing.
lines.style: Thoughtful turn toward bigger questions. Lifting the conversation higher without dismissing what came before. Curious, not didactic.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦乱に堪える民衆、史料に多く描かれています。
lines.en: Yes. The common people enduring through all that warfare — the historical sources describe that situation quite extensively.
lines.style: Measured and careful. He's stating fact but there's respect underneath it. Steady pace, no rush. The weight of what he's describing is allowed to sit.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 卒論の年表、整理が、見事ですね、桜さん。
lines.en: Your thesis timeline is really well organized, Sakura.
lines.style: Direct praise, warmly delivered. Slight lift in her voice — she's pleased and not hiding it. Brief, genuine, the kind of feedback that lands.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。地方のしきたり、地域研究で、扱いました。
lines.en: Yes. We worked through the local customs and traditions as part of the regional research.
lines.style: Closing note, calm and modest. Not overstating his contribution. Simple clarity. A small smile in his voice if anything.
